steps.action:
Navigate to Gantt module of the boxName
Check if baselineColumnView is selected
steps.data:
boxName: TC-4736 Box Module - Gantt - Baselines - Managing mutliple baselines

baselineColumnView: Baseline
steps.result:
Gantt (WBS and Gantt chart) module is displayed.
Following tasks are visible:
Project task: TC-4736 Box Module - Gantt - Baselines - Managing mutliple baselines
4 project's task child tasks:

* Task A
* Task B
* Task C
* Task D

There is a baseline under every taskbar with Start Date: 27.05.2024 and End Date: 31.05.2024

steps.action: In header menu click Data > hover over Baselines (Current baseline dropdown)> hover over Version history (Show on timeline dropdown)
steps.result:
There is a dropdown visible with title: 
Show on Timeline 
and 5 radio buttons visible:

* Lowest
* Baseline 4 to restore
* Baseline 3 to delete
* Baseline 2 to edit
* Baseline 1

steps.action: In Current Baseline dropdown click on Manage Baselines
steps.result:
Baselines box configuration page is opened with folLowing elements visible:

- Title: Baseline
- Text: Baselines help track deviations from the initial schedule.

*Permissions section*
- Permissions title
- Text: Decide who can create, delete and save baselines.
- dropdown with selected option: Box Admin and Box Editors
- Save button

*Version history section*
Table with list of saved baselines with visible Name, Creation Date, Created By, Color

Each saved baseline, in the last column of the table, has also 3 buttons available:
- Restore to current baseline button with history icon
- Edit details button with edit icon
- Delete button with trash icon

steps.action: In Version history section click on the Edit details button for baselineToEdit saved baseline
steps.result:
Edit details modal window is visible with baseline name input and color picker.
There are buttons Save and Cancel visible and active.

steps.action: Change baseline name from baselineToEdit to baselineEdited and click Save button
steps.data:
baselineToEdit: Baseline 2 to edit
baselineEdited: Baseline 2 EDITED
steps.result: Baseline name is changed to Baseline 2 EDITED in Version history section.

steps.action: In Version history section click on the Delete button for baselineToDelete
steps.result:
There is a confirmation dialog visible with text:
Delete from version history? This baseline will be gone for good.
and 2 active buttons: Confirm button and Cancel button

Baseline 2 to delete is removed and is not visible on the saved baselines list.
There are now 3 saved baselines visible in the Version history section:

* Baseline 4 to restore
* Baseline 2 to edit
* Baseline 1

steps.action:
Back to Gantt module (Back to Gantt button)  
In header menu click Data > hover over Baselines (Current baseline dropdown)> hover over Version history (Show on timeline dropdown)
steps.result:
There is a dropdown visible with title: 
Show on Timeline 
and now 4 radio buttons are visible:

* Lowest
* Baseline 4 to restore
* Baseline 2 EDITED
* Baseline 1

steps.action: In Show on Timeline dropdown select baselineCheckboxRestore
steps.result:
Checkbox Baseline 4 to restore is checked.

Saved baselines are visible on Gantt chart with Start Date: 20.05.2024 and End Date: 24.05.2024

Tasks are visible on Gantt chart with current baseline with Start Date: 27.05.2024 and End Date: 31.05.2024

steps.action: In Current Baseline dropdown click on Manage Baselines and in Version history section click on Restore button for baseline with baselineToRestore name
steps.result:
There is a warning dialog visible with text:
Restore to current baseline?

It will replace the current baseline you use now. Make sure to save your baselines to the version history in case you need them later.

2 active buttons are visible: Cancel button and Restore and Replace button

steps.action: Click on Restore and Replace button and after that Back to Gantt module
steps.result:
On Gantt chart there are now 2 baselines for each task visible. 
Current Baseline with Start Date: 20.05.2024 and End Date: 24.05.2024
and
Saved Baseline: Baseline 4 to restore with the same dates.
